name: PortfolioWebsite
summary: An interactive software portfolio with a Phaser game and a conventional project, blog, and about site.
description: The repository contains a React and TypeScript Vite website. Its root route serves a keyboard and gamepad controlled Phaser portfolio experience; /notGame serves the text portfolio with home, projects, game design blog, about, and image upload routes. The separate Go Fiber backend and the frontend's existing external API URLs remain upstream-owned and are not rewritten by this integration.
features: Explore an interactive Phaser portfolio using keyboard or gamepad controls
Browse the text portfolio at /notGame, including home, projects, blog, and about routes
View project showcases, experience, and technology stacks
Open and download full stack and DevOps resumes
Use an existing Go Fiber backend for article and image operations through its configured external API URLs

sections.title: Interactive Phaser portfolio
sections.summary: The root route opens a top down portfolio game with keyboard and gamepad controls, interactive project objects, a map, and resume panels.

sections.title: Text portfolio
sections.summary: The /notGame route provides the conventional portfolio site with home, projects, about, and image upload pages.

sections.title: Project showcase
sections.summary: Project pages present software and game work, technology choices, and external project links.

sections.title: Game design blog
sections.summary: The text portfolio includes game design blog and article routes backed by the existing external API configuration.

frontend.reason: The nested Vite frontend is assembled as the monorepo root site; /projects/portfoliowebsite/ is not generated.
